dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, that doesn't sound quite right to me...

dialogues.speaker: Vyorskaya
dialogues.text: I'd have agreed with you ten years ago, when I was that Shagova's age.

dialogues.speaker: Vyorskaya
dialogues.text: Shagova... That little fool. She thinks that she'll become someone if she works hard enough.

dialogues.speaker: Vyorskaya
dialogues.text: I remember the days when I was Sretomorozsk's Train Attendant of the Year for years running. Everyone kept saying that young Vyorskaya was bound to be promoted to Snezhnograd sooner or later.

dialogues.speaker: Vyorskaya
dialogues.text: But in the end? Every year, right here in this station, I would watch someone else go off to Snezhnograd instead. They'd either be a relative of the mayor's, or someone with a connection to the stationmaster...

dialogues.speaker: Vyorskaya
dialogues.text: That's when I knew. Forget fairy tales. Better to just live comfortably right here, right now, every day.
